description: This plot illustrates the training loss across iterations for various model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick marks at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six solid lines, all lacking markers and accompanied by lighter shaded regions. All lines exhibit a steep initial decline from a value above 3.4 near 0 iterations, transitioning into a steady, gradual decrease across the remainder of the x-axis. The blue line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", declines to approximately 2.62 at 140000 iterations. The orange line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", declines to approximately 2.53 at 140000 iterations. The green line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", declines to approximately 2.51 at 140000 iterations. The dark blue line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", follows a nearly identical path to the green line, also ending at approximately 2.51 at 140000 iterations. The red line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", declines to approximately 2.49 at 140000 iterations. Finally, a purple line corresponding to an unlabeled legend entry with a grey box shows the lowest final value, declining to approximately 2.46 at 140000 iterations.
